Exclude selectors work in plain text output mode

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"exclude_selectors\":[\".nav\"],\"output_format\":\"Plain\"}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<body><div class=\"nav\">Navigation</div><p>Article body</p></body>", options)
    println(result)
}
```
